rationale: Applying SHOCK_ABSORBER (alpha = 0.10) to upstream tiers suppresses ongoing bullwhip amplification and prevents excess inventory holding costs from building up in the distributor and warehouse pipelines, while maintaining CRUISER at the retailer to track nominal demand.
